name: whip-proxy-test
description: Not a workspace member (root package.json's workspaces glob is apps/*, packages/* only — this directory is deliberately outside both, so `bun run test`/`bun run typecheck` from the repo root never touch it). A standalone harness that drives a real RTCPeerConnection against infra/nginx/live-hls.conf.template's /whip/ location through a real nginx container. See run.sh for usage.
